_note: Punjabi names for calendar events, kept apart from calendar-558.json because that file is regenerated from the supplied .docx and the document is English only. These ten came with the earlier partial calendar and are carried across verbatim -- the event is the same one, and the Gurmukhi is the text that was reviewed then. Nothing here is translated: an event with no entry ships with no Punjabi and the reader falls back to English, which is the same rule the meanings follow. Add to this file only from a reviewed source. `en` is matched alongside `date` so a changed event name fails the build instead of silently attaching the wrong Gurmukhi.
